scientific_integrity: The all-edge-tight bipartite criterion is established prior literature and is credited, not claimed as new. Both facet and orbit formulas and the asymptotic are proved in the included result. Novelty is best knowledge under the inspected sources; an independently performed scientific audit is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional Lipschitz-free spaces of once-subdivided unweighted complete graphs; orbit classification is for graph automorphisms and global sign, and order at least four. No claims about general graph subdivisions, all polytope isometries, or higher face numbers. Small-order exact computations support but do not replace the proof.
title: Facet entropy and graph-complement orbits of subdivided complete-graph transportation balls
